verses.en: O God, where art thou? And where is the pavilion that covereth thy hiding place?
verses.sm: Le Atua e, o fea ea lau afio? Ma o fea o i ai le faapaologa ua ufitia ai lou lafitaga?

verses.en: How long shall thy hand be stayed, and thine eye, yea thy pure eye, behold from the eternal heavens the wrongs of thy people and of thy servants, and thine ear be penetrated with their cries?
verses.sm: O le a le umi e taofia ai lou aao, ma silasila mai ai mai le lagi faavavau lou fofoga, ioe, lou fofoga manino, i sese ua faia i lou nuu ma au auauna, ma oo atu ai i ou fofoga o a latou tagi?

verses.en: Yea, O Lord, how long shall they suffer these wrongs and unlawful oppressions, before thine heart shall be softened toward them, and thy bowels be moved with compassion toward them?
verses.sm: Ioe, le Alii e, o le a le umi latou te mafatia ai i nei sese ma sauaga e lē tusa ai ma le tulafono, ae lei faamalūlūina lou finagalo ia te i latou, ma uunaia ai lou finagalo i le agaalofa ia te i latou?

verses.en: O Lord God Almighty, maker of heaven, earth, and seas, and of all things that in them are, and who controllest and subjectest the devil, and the dark and benighted dominion of Sheol—stretch forth thy hand; let thine eye pierce; let thy pavilion be taken up; let thy hiding place no longer be covered; let thine ear be inclined; let thine heart be softened, and thy bowels moved with compassion toward us.
verses.sm: E, le Alii e le Atua Malosi Aoao, o Lē na faia le lagi, lalolagi, ma sami, ma mea uma o i ai, o lē na te taofiofi ma pulea le tiapolo, ma le malo pogisa ma faapouliuligia o Seoli—faaloaloa mai ia lou aao; sei ati mai ia lou fofoga-silasila; sei to a’e ia i luga lou faapaologa; ia lē toe punia lou lafitaga; sei uai mai ia ou fofoga; sei faamalūlūina lou finagalo, ma liuliu mai ia lou finagalo agaalofa ia te i matou.

w.en: and all things that are in them.

verses.en: Let thine anger be kindled against our enemies; and, in the fury of thine heart, with thy sword avenge us of our wrongs.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu lou toasa e sasao faasaga i o matou fili; ma, ia e tauimasui i matou i le toasa tele o lou finagalo ma lau pelu, mo sese ua faia ia te i matou.

verses.en: Remember thy suffering saints, O our God; and thy servants will rejoice in thy name forever.
verses.sm: Ia manatua lau au paia mafatia, lo matou Atua e; ma o le a olioli ai au auauna i lou suafa e faavavau.

verses.en: My son, peace be unto thy soul; thine adversity and thine afflictions shall be but a small moment;
verses.sm: Lo’u atalii e, ia filemu lou agaga; o lou tiga ma ou puapuaga o le a na o sina taimi laitiiti;

verses.en: And then, if thou endure it well, God shall exalt thee on high; thou shalt triumph over all thy foes.
verses.sm: Ma ona oo lea, afai e te gafatia lelei, o le a faaeaina oe e le Atua i lugā; o le a e manumalo i ou fili uma.

verses.en: Thy friends do stand by thee, and they shall hail thee again with warm hearts and friendly hands.
verses.sm: O loo tutulai au uo i ou tafatafa, ma o le a latou toe faafeiloa’i ia te oe ma loto mafana ma lima faauo.

verses.en: Thou art not yet as Job; thy friends do not contend against thee, neither charge thee with transgression, as they did Job.
verses.sm: E lei avea lava oe e pei o Iopu; e lē o finau au uo faasaga mai ia te oe, pe tuua’i oe i se solitulafono, e pei ona latou faia ia Iopu.

verses.en: And they who do charge thee with transgression, their hope shall be blasted, and their prospects shall melt away as the hoar frost melteth before the burning rays of the rising sun;
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e ua tuua’ia oe i le solitulafono, o le a lepetiaina lo latou faamoemoe, ma o o latou faamoeme o le a liusuavai ese e pei ona liusuavai le sau to’a i luma o ave mumū o le la oso;

verses.en: And also that God hath set his hand and seal to change the times and seasons, and to blind their minds, that they may not understand his marvelous workings; that he may prove them also and take them in their own craftiness;
verses.sm: O lenei foi ua faatuina e le Atua lona aao ma le faamaufaailoga e sui ai taimi ma tau, ma faatauaso o latou mafaufau, ina ia lē mafai ona latou malamalama i ana galuega ofoofogia; ina ia mafai ona faamaonia ai foi e ia i latou ma maua ai i latou ia latou lava togafiti;

verses.en: Also because their hearts are corrupted, and the things which they are willing to bring upon others, and love to have others suffer, may come upon themselves to the very uttermost;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ona ua eleelea o latou loto, o mea foi ua latou naunau ia aumaia i luga o isi, ma fiafia ia mafatia ai isi, e mafai ona oo mai i o latou lava luga i le atoatoa a’ia’i;

verses.en: That they may be disappointed also, and their hopes may be cut off;
verses.sm: Ina ia latou faanoanoa ai foi, ma ia vavae ese ai o latou faamoemoe;

verses.en: And not many years hence, that they and their posterity shall be swept from under heaven, saith God, that not one of them is left to stand by the wall.
verses.sm: Ma e lē tele ni tausaga mai le taimi nei, ae o le a tafia ese i latou ma a latou fanau mai i lalo o le lagi, ua fetalai mai ai le Atua, ina seia leai se toatasi o i latou e totoe e tulai i tafatafa o le pa.

verses.en: Cursed are all those that shall lift up the heel against mine anointed, saith the Lord, and cry they have sinned when they have not sinned before me, saith the Lord, but have done that which was meet in mine eyes, and which I commanded them.
verses.sm: Ia fetuuina lava i latou uma o e e siia’e i luga le mulivae e faasaga i a’u ’au faauuina, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, ma alaga ua latou agasala ae ua lē agasala i latou i o’u luma, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, ae ua latou faia mea na tatau ai i o’u mata, ma na Ou poloaiina ai i latou.

verses.en: But those who cry transgression do it because they are the servants of sin, and are the children of disobedience themselves.
verses.sm: Ae o i latou o e ua alalaga ua solitulafono, ua latou faia lea mea ona o i latou o auauna a le agasala, ma o fanau i latou lava o le lē usiusitai.

verses.en: And those who swear falsely against my servants, that they might bring them into bondage and death—
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e e tauto pepelo e faasaga i a’u auauna, ina ia latou aumai i latou i le pologa ma le oti—

verses.en: Wo unto them; because they have offended my little ones they shall be severed from the ordinances of mine house.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te i latou; ona ua latou faatausuai i a’u fanau iti, o le a vavae ese i latou mai sauniga o lo’u fale.

verses.en: Their basket shall not be full, their houses and their barns shall perish, and they themselves shall be despised by those that flattered them.
verses.sm: O le a lē tumu la latou ato, o le a fano o latou fale ma a latou falemanu, ma o le a inosia i latou lava e i latou o e na faaseeina i latou.

verses.en: They shall not have right to the priesthood, nor their posterity after them from generation to generation.
verses.sm: O le a latou lē maua le aiā i le perisitua, po o a latou fanau pe a mavae atu i latou mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: It had been better for them that a millstone had been hanged about their necks, and they drowned in the depth of the sea.
verses.sm: Sa sili ona lelei mo i latou pe a na nonoa se maaolo i o latou ūa, ma malelemo ai i latou i le loloto o le sami.

verses.en: Wo unto all those that discomfort my people, and drive, and murder, and testify against them, saith the Lord of Hosts; a generation of vipers shall not escape the damnation of hell.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia i latou uma o e ua faaatuatuvaleina o’u tagata, ma tulia, ma fasiotia, ma molimau faasaga ia te i latou, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii o ’Au; o le a lē sao lava se tupulaga o gata feai mai le malaia o seoli.

verses.en: Behold, mine eyes see and know all their works, and I have in reserve a swift judgment in the season thereof, for them all;
verses.sm: Faauta, ua vaai o’u mata ma iloa a latou galuega uma, ma ua Ou faaagagaina se faamasinoga vave i lona tau, mo i latou uma;

verses.en: For there is a time appointed for every man, according as his works shall be.
verses.sm: Aua ua i ai se taimi atofaina mo tagata taitoatasi, e tusa ai ma ana galuega.

verses.en: God shall give unto you knowledge by his Holy Spirit, yea, by the unspeakable gift of the Holy Ghost, that has not been revealed since the world was until now;
verses.sm: O le a tuu atu e le Atua ia te outou le poto e ala i lona Agaga Paia, ioe, e ala i le meaalofa lē mafaamatalaina a le Agaga Paia, sa lei faaalia lava talu ona i ai le lalolagi sei oo mai i le taimi nei;

verses.en: Which our forefathers have awaited with anxious expectation to be revealed in the last times, which their minds were pointed to by the angels, as held in reserve for the fulness of their glory;
verses.sm: Lea sa faatalitali i ai tua’ā o o tatou tua’ā ma le faamoemoe naunautai e faaali mai i taimi mulimuli, lea sa faasino atu i ai o latou mafaufau e agelu, e pei ona taofia faaagaga mo le atoatoaga o lo latou mamalu;

verses.en: A time to come in the which nothing shall be withheld, whether there be one God or many gods, they shall be manifest.
verses.sm: E oo mai se taimi o le a leai ai se mea o le a taofia, pe toatasi se Atua o i ai pe toatele ni atua, o le a faaali mai lava i latou.

verses.en: All thrones and dominions, principalities and powers, shall be revealed and set forth upon all who have endured valiantly for the gospel of Jesus Christ.
verses.sm: O nofoalii ma malo, itumalo ma mana uma, o le a faaali ma tuu mai i luga o i latou uma o e na tumau ma le lototoa mo le talalelei a Iesu Keriso.

verses.en: And also, if there be bounds set to the heavens or to the seas, or to the dry land, or to the sun, moon, or stars—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, afai e i ai ni tuaoi ua faatutuina i le lagi po o le sami, po o i le laueleele matutu, po o i le la, masina, po o fetu—

verses.en: All the times of their revolutions, all the appointed days, months, and years, and all the days of their days, months, and years, and all their glories, laws, and set times, shall be revealed in the days of the dispensation of the fulness of times—
verses.sm: O taimi uma o a latou taamilosaga, o aso atofaina uma, masina, ma tausaga, ma aso uma o o latou aso, masina, ma tausaga, ma o latou mamalu uma, tulafono, ma taimi faatutuina, o le a faaali mai i aso o le tisipenisione o le atoaga o taimi—

verses.en: According to that which was ordained in the midst of the Council of the Eternal God of all other gods before this world was, that should be reserved unto the finishing and the end thereof, when every man shall enter into his eternal presence and into his immortal rest.
verses.sm: E tusa ma lena na faauuina i totonu o le Aufono a le Atua Faavavau o isi atua uma ae lei i ai le lalolagi lenei, e tatau ona faaagaga mo le faamae’aina ma lona iuga, pe a ulu atu tagata taitoatasi i lona afioaga faavavau ma i lona malologa ola pea.

verses.en: How long can rolling waters remain impure? What power shall stay the heavens? As well might man stretch forth his puny arm to stop the Missouri river in its decreed course, or to turn it up stream, as to hinder the Almighty from pouring down knowledge from heaven upon the heads of the Latter-day Saints.
verses.sm: O le a le umi e mafai ona tumau ai vai e tafe i le eleelea? O le a le mana e taofia ai le lagi? E pei ona lē mafai e le tagata ona faaloaloa atu lona lima faatauvaa e taofi ai le vaitafe o le Misuri i lona ala faatonuina, pe toe liliu ai i tua lona tafe, ua faapena ona lē mafai ona taofia le Malosi Aoao mai le liligi ifo o le malamalama mai le lagi i luga o ulu o le Au Paia o Aso e Gata Ai.

verses.en: Behold, there are many called, but few are chosen. And why are they not chosen?
verses.sm: Faauta, e toatele e e valaaulia, ae toaitiiti e ua filifilia. Ma, pe aisea e lē filifilia ai i latou?

verses.en: Because their hearts are set so much upon the things of this world, and aspire to the honors of men, that they do not learn this one lesson—
verses.sm: Aua ua pupū tele o latou loto i mea o lenei lalolagi, ma saili i viiga a tagata, ua latou lē aoaoina ai le lesona lenei e tasi—

verses.en: That the rights of the priesthood are inseparably connected with the powers of heaven, and that the powers of heaven cannot be controlled nor handled only upon the principles of righteousness.
verses.sm: O aiā a le perisitua ua fesootai e lē mavavaeeseina ma mana o le lagi, ma o mana o le lagi e lē mafai ona pulea pe faaaogaina tau lava i mataupu autu o le amiotonu.

verses.en: That they may be conferred upon us, it is true; but when we undertake to cover our sins, or to gratify our pride, our vain ambition, or to exercise control or dominion or compulsion upon the souls of the children of men, in any degree of unrighteousness, behold, the heavens withdraw themselves; the Spirit of the Lord is grieved; and when it is withdrawn, Amen to the priesthood or the authority of that man.
verses.sm: Atonu e mafai ona faaee mai i latou i luga o i tatou, e moni; ae a tatou taumafai e ufiufi a tatou agasala, pe faamalie lo tatou faamaualuga, lo tatou fiasili lē aoga, pe faaaoga ai le pule po o le puleaga po o le faamalosi i luga o agaga o le fanauga a tagata, i soo se tikeri o le amioletonu, faauta, e aveese e le lagi i latou lava; e faanoanoa le Agaga o le Alii; ma a aveesea, Amene i le perisitua po o le pule a lena tagata.

verses.en: Behold, ere he is aware, he is left unto himself, to kick against the pricks, to persecute the saints, and to fight against God.
verses.sm: Faauta, ae lei iloa e ia, ua tuua o ia ia te ia lava, e a’a i tui, e faasaua i le au paia, ma tau faasaga i le Atua.

verses.en: We have learned by sad experience that it is the nature and disposition of almost all men, as soon as they get a little authority, as they suppose, they will immediately begin to exercise unrighteous dominion.
verses.sm: Ua tatou aoao e ala i mea faanoanoa e tutupu mai e faapea o le natura ma le uiga o le toeitiitii lava o tagata uma, o le vave lava latou te maua ai sina pule itiiti, e pei ona latou manatu i ai, e vave lava ona latou amata le faaaogaina o le puleaga amioletonu.

verses.en: Hence many are called, but few are chosen.
verses.sm: O lena e toatele ai e e valaaulia, ae toaitiiti e ua filifilia.

verses.en: No power or influence can or ought to be maintained by virtue of the priesthood, only by persuasion, by long-suffering, by gentleness and meekness, and by love unfeigned;
verses.sm: E leai se mana po o se aafiaga e mafai pe tatau ona faatumauina ona o le perisitua, nao i le faatauanau, i le tali-tiga, i le agamaualalo ma le agamalu, ma le alofa faamaoni;

verses.en: By kindness, and pure knowledge, which shall greatly enlarge the soul without hypocrisy, and without guile—
verses.sm: I le agalelei, ma le malamalama manino, lea o le a faalautele sili ai le agaga e aunoa ma le faagutugutulua, ma aunoa ma le faa’ole’ole—

verses.en: Reproving betimes with sharpness, when moved upon by the Holy Ghost; and then showing forth afterwards an increase of love toward him whom thou hast reproved, lest he esteem thee to be his enemy;
verses.sm: E aoai atu i taimi e tatau ai ma le tuusao, pe a uunaia ai e le Agaga Paia; ma ona faaali atu ai lea pe a mavae, o se alofa faateleina ia te ia o lē na e aoaiina, ne’i manatu o ia ia te oe o sona fili;

verses.en: That he may know that thy faithfulness is stronger than the cords of death.
verses.sm: Ina ia iloa ai e ia e sili atu le malosi o lou faamaoni i lo fusi o le oti.

verses.en: Let thy bowels also be full of charity towards all men, and to the household of faith, and let virtue garnish thy thoughts unceasingly; then shall thy confidence wax strong in the presence of God; and the doctrine of the priesthood shall distil upon thy soul as the dews from heaven.
verses.sm: Ia tuu foi lou loto ia tumu i le alofa mama i tagata uma, ma i le auaiga o le faatuatua, ma ia tuu le amiomamā e teuteuina ai ou mafaufauga e lē aunoa; ona faasolo malosi ai lea o lou lototele i luma o le Atua; ma o le a to ifo i luga o lou agaga le mataupu faavae o le perisitua e pei o le sau mai le lagi.

verses.en: The Holy Ghost shall be thy constant companion, and thy scepter an unchanging scepter of righteousness and truth; and thy dominion shall be an everlasting dominion, and without compulsory means it shall flow unto thee forever and ever.
verses.sm: O le a avea le Agaga Paia ma āu soa e lē aunoa, ma o lou tootoo o le a avea ma se tootoo lē feliuliua’i o le amiotonu ma le upumoni; ma o lau puleaga o le a avea ma se puleaga tumau e faavavau, ma e aunoa ma ni ala faamalosia, o le a tafe mai ia te oe e faavavau faavavau lava.
